'''Kol Nurn''' was an [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] and patron of [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] mandated curfew.<ref name="hs" /> He sat near a [[Tintinna/Legends|Tintinna]], [[Rungs]].

==Behind the scenes==
This Advozse was previously unidentified until the [[Star Wars Blog]] article, ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special Cantina: Who's Who]]'' identified both him and his companion, the Tintinna, Rungs. The author of the article speculated that this Advozse actually looked similar to [[Bom Vimdin/Legends|Bom Vimdin]], but Vimdin had already been identified as a different Advozse in the cantina, necessitating a different name for this character.
